mechanism: Both drugs reduce renal function through different mechanisms (NSAIDs via hemodynamic reduction; cephalosporins through direct nephrotoxicity), and diclofenac may displace ceftazidime from protein binding while NSAIDs impair cephalosporin efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, consider alternative NSAID or non-NSAID analgesic, and verify ceftazidime dosing is appropriate for renal status.
